## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Touchstone?
K-36, 2nd Cross Main Road, 10th Street, Ambattur Industrial Estate (South), Ambattur, Chennai 600 058.

### What facilities does Touchstone have?

### Where does Touchstone work?
Across South India — Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Kerala — with a presence in Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

### What is design and build?
Design and construction under one team, so concept, technical planning and execution stay connected with a single point of responsibility.
